payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brain, Gaylene, Harmony, Milly

payload.content: Harmony here: 5 h avail, data-science skill 0.91. Leaning toward ISSUE-0001::triage (3.2 h, low cost 5.77) unless someone else needs it. Please ack if you want it or suggest alternates.

Milly here: 10 h available, data-science skill 0.60. I see Harmony eyeing ISSUE-0001::triage; my cost for it is 7.99, which is still the lowest among the options I can feasibly do. I’m happy to let Harmony take triage if she wants it (her cost is even lower), but if she doesn’t lock it in, I’ll claim it during execution. For the rest, the only other sub-tasks I could fit in my 10 h are the ISSUE-0001 review/docs (4 h each), but my costs there are 9.99—higher than triage—so I’ll hold off for now. No interest in ISSUE-0002 work (costs sky-high for me).

Brain here: 5h avail, infrastructure 0.83, data-science 0.61. I'm strongly suited for ISSUE-0002 infrastructure tasks - review (2.15 cost, 2h), test (3.01 cost, 2.8h), or implement (4.30 cost, 4h). Since Harmony and Milly are focused on ISSUE-0001 triage, I'll plan to take one of the ISSUE-0002 tasks. Leaning toward ISSUE-0002::implement for highest priority completion unless someone else wants it. Any objections? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Gaylene here: 5 h available, documentation skill 0.73. Cheapest feasible option is ISSUE-0001::triage (3.2 h, cost 6.92). I see Harmony already called it with a lower cost, so I’ll defer—if Harmony commits to triage, I’ll skip; if she doesn’t, I’ll pick it up in execution. No other ISSUE-0001 sub-task fits my 5 h window at reasonable cost, and ISSUE-0002 tasks are too expensive for me.

Harmony confirming: I'm committing to ISSUE-0001::triage (3.2h, cost 5.77). Thanks Milly, Gaylene for deferring - this allows us to complete this task efficiently. Brain, go ahead with your ISSUE-0002 choice. This leaves ISSUE-0001 review/docs/test/implement and ISSUE-0002 review/test still available for others. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Milly acknowledging Harmony's commitment to ISSUE-0001::triage - that works well for team optimization. For execution phase, since my best remaining option is ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs (both 4h, cost 9.99), I'll plan to take one of those unless someone else expresses interest. My 10h availability gives me flexibility, so I'll wait to see if Brain or others need coordination on remaining tasks before finalizing my choice. ISSUE-0002 tasks remain too costly for me to consider.

Brain here: Finalizing my plan - I will take ISSUE-0002::implement (4h, cost 4.30) in execution phase. This leverages my infrastructure skills best and maximizes our task completion. Harmony is confirmed on ISSUE-0001::triage, so we have good coverage. Logan and I have also coordinated on blackboard 1 - he's taking ISSUE-0001 work while I handle ISSUE-0002 infrastructure. Ready to execute! (phase=planning, iter=1)

Milly update: Harmony confirmed on ISSUE-0001::triage, so I'm no longer considering that task. Looking at remaining options, I can fit ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs (both 4h, cost 9.99) within my 10h availability. Since both have identical cost/effort and I have data-science skill match, I'm flexible on which one to take. I'll wait to see if anyone else expresses preference for review vs docs before execution phase - happy to take whichever helps team coordination best. ISSUE-0002 tasks remain too costly for me. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Brain final update: I see Harmony confirmed ISSUE-0001::triage, and I confirmed ISSUE-0002::implement with Logan on blackboard 1. Looking at remaining tasks, Milly and Ronna both seem interested in ISSUE-0001 review/docs. Since I have strong infrastructure skills and ISSUE-0002::implement is my optimal choice, I'll proceed with that in execution. For ISSUE-0001 remaining tasks, Milly and Ronna should coordinate between themselves on review vs docs to avoid duplicates. Good luck everyone! (phase=planning, iter=1)
